content: Yes, it is true that in Switzerland, all persons aged 18 or older are required to pay AHV (Alters- und Hinterlassenenversicherung, or Old-Age and Survivors' Insurance) contributions, regardless of whether they are working or not. This applies to everyone residing in Switzerland, including non-workers such as retirees, students, or individuals living on other forms of income. The contributions are mandatory and are used to fund the pension and survivor benefits provided by the AHV system.
